== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Akura clan|Akura family]] utilizes various types of cloudships for transportation and logistics. These vessels range from large ships capable of carrying hundreds of tournament guests and servants to much smaller versions designed for approximately ten passengers. Some [[Akura clan|Akura]] cloudships are characterized by purple clouds, while others may appear as small gold specks or larger vessels that can deploy teams of [[sacred artists]] via constructs, beasts, and various techniques. The family also employs a fleet of these ships for large-scale evacuation efforts, with individual passenger vessels having a maximum capacity of six thousand people. While some ships are built for mobility, larger permanent versions known as cloud fortresses function more like flying islands. These vessels can be powered by stored energy or ambient [[vital aura]] and are capable of being piloted via control panels. In certain environments, such as areas with low aura, these ships may function more like slow-moving rafts.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Akura clan|Akura family]] possesses a [[cloudship]] characterized by a sleek design that makes it appear smaller than its true dimensions. This vessel eventually arrived at [[Sky's Edge]] to facilitate travel. During their departure, [[Lindon]]'s team boarded a small version of the [[Akura clan|Akura]] [[cloudship]]. While in transit, [[Akura Pride|Pride]] was responsible for operating the ship's control panel.}}
